content.query:
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CbcCifNumber) AS AddressId,
    *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CUST.ORGKEY AS CbcCifNumber,
        ADDR.ADDRESSCATEGORY AS AddressType,

        CASE 
            WHEN ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT = 'STRUCTURED_FORMAT' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    ADDR.SUBURB, ' ',
                    ADDR.PREMISE_NAME, ' ',
                    ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL, ' ',
                    ADDR.STREET_NAME
                )
            ELSE
                ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE1
        END AS Address1,

        CASE 
            WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT = 'STRUCTURED_FORMAT' THEN
                        CONCAT(
                            ADDR.SUBURB, ' ',
                            ADDR.PREMISE_NAME, ' ',
                            ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL, ' ',
                            ADDR.STREET_NAME
                        )
                    ELSE
                        CONCAT(
                            ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2, ' ',
                            ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3, ' ',
                            ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT
                        )
                END

            WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2, ' ',
                    ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3
                )
        END AS Address2,

        ADDR.COUNTRY AS Country,
        ADDR.STATE   AS State,
        ADDR.CITY    AS City,
        ADDR.ZIP     AS Zip
    FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_ADDRESS ADDR
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = ADDR.ORGKEY
    WHERE 
        CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
        AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1
) TEMP
ORDER BY AddressId;
